_schema: W12 diff-adjudication registry (user ruling 2026-11-18, GAPS 2.2#12): the sandbox realchain battery performs NO bug adjudication — every divergence is exported to .test-logs/diff-reports/ and matched here. Entry fields: id, scenario_pattern (exact scenario or '*'), state_pattern (optional, default '*'), shape ({kind: substring|regex, ref_contains/rust_contains/any_contains: all must appear in the divergence line, rust_missing/ref_missing: none may appear}), classification (framework-diff|env-artifact|accepted-gap|expected-shape|real-bug|needs-controller), justification, g_ref, adjudicated_by, adjudicated_at, last_observed. Matching is most-specific-first (longest scenario_pattern, then file order); a divergence matched by NO entry = unadjudicated (checker exit 2 = merge gate red). SEMANTIC FORK (review C-1): an expected-shape entry describes the VIOLATION form — a match is a RED in adjudicate.py, and its green channel is the scenario/state report existing without a matching divergence.

entries.justification: RESOLVED REAL BUG (G-454 lane 2026-11-18; both review I-1 confounders run first): D1 omo-slim-ONLY does NOT block (main turn fires in 24ms; strict-miss 404 is seed business); D2 writable (0644) staging does NOT unblock; D3 superpowers-ALONE blocks (requests=1 forever) => true bug. Forensic chain (daemon-side env-gated trace + patched-plugin breadcrumbs, all reverted): the main turn's session.context hook dispatch into the superpowers guest never returns. Root cause is a two-defect coincidence: (1) oc-server plugins.rs session_info_json serialized an unset parent as explicit "parentID": null (the ref's effect schema OMITS the field), so superpowers' #2160 child-session guard threw 'invalid parent identity' and the plugin logged a console.error (fail-open, benign by design); (2) that error-level guest log hit oc-plugin-host supervisor.rs log_guest's eprintln! on the guest-stdout READER task — the detached daemon's stderr pipe has no reader once the spawning 'service start' process exits, so the panicking stderr write KILLED the reader task, freezing the whole plugin RPC bridge: the hook.dispatch answer never arrived, the 120s mutating timeout fired, and the turn aborted before HTTP (the W13 forever-spinner). FIX: (a) stderrln! macro replaces every eprintln! on oc-plugin-host tasks (non-panicking stderr write); (b) session_info_json emits parentID only when set. REGRESSION: oc-tui realchain_g454 (both/omo-only/superpowers-only/writable all assert requests>=2); w13-omo pair rig now shows 4 gateway requests (rust main turn arrives, 59,864B). RESIDUAL (new gap, out of G-454 scope, needs its own G#): with superpowers loaded the rust main-turn request still differs from ref's recorded shape — rust adds cache_control on the omo system-reminder user part, omits additionalProperties:false on the ast_grep_replace tool schema, and the MCP catalog text differs — so the w13-omo reply stays a strict miss (reply-render survey 0/1).

G-449 fixed (W13): both ends now carry the model constant 'New session' as the untitled tab title; the residual p1-busy/p2-mid line-1 divergence is the spinner GLYPH phase at capture (⠋/⠧/⠸) — the same capture-phase artifact family as w12-midstream-spinner-phase.
